Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Covers the core SQL DDL concepts—including what DDL is and how it differs from other SQL sublanguages, the CREATE command for databases and schemas, numeric/string/date data types, and key constraints (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, NOT NULL)—serving as the outline that organizes the module's learning topics for both learners navigating the content and instructors structuring their lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the topics covered in the SQL DDL module—including what DDL is, how it differs from other SQL sublanguages, and how it is used to define and manage database structures—serving as a navigational overview for learners to understand what they will study.
